title: viza.finance.equity_investment v0.1 — Shared Registry Metadata Contract
description: Strict, machine-enforceable contract that every registry record in viza.finance.equity_investment v0.1 must satisfy. Companion to docs/equity_module/v0.1/shared_metadata_contract.md. Source of truth: docs/CLAUDE_EQUITY_MODULE.md. Baseline: Phase 35 + post-phase remediation + 2026-05-13 packaged-engine/runtime hardening.

id.description: snake_case unique key within the object family.

source_sections.description: CLAUDE_EQUITY_MODULE.md section references; each entry matches the §N or §N.M[.K] form.

source_ids.description: Source IDs from the global CLAUDE source corpus. May be empty only when confidence_label is research_supported_experimental, practitioner_observed, speculative_or_low_confidence, or rejected_or_deferred.

confidence_label_pre_recalibration.description: Original confidence label before the 2026-05-14 recalibration pass. Optional; present only when the record was downgraded.

recalibration_notes.description: Audit trail for the 2026-05-14 confidence recalibration pass. Optional; present only when the record was downgraded.

source_quality_minimum.description: Lowest acceptable source_quality_score of any cited source_id.

allOf.description: If observed_at_policy is concrete (not not_applicable), available_at_policy must also be concrete.
Restrictive default: unknown data_version_policy forces vintage_required=true and lookahead_risk=high.
Restrictive default: unknown available_at_policy forces lookahead_risk=high.
Restrictive default: unknown or restricted_or_unclear license forces blocked/conditional export, redacted/blocked marketplace, and redaction_required=true.
Licensed provider data blocks redistribution and restricts marketplace.
Internal research only blocks all export and marketplace.
Derived-only license allows display and derived export but blocks raw redistribution.

family_specific.description: Family-specific extension fields; selected via the top-level oneOf below.

allOf.description: Confidence-label promotion gate: core / common_practice requires source_ids, evidence_requirements, and failure_modes.
Source-lineage gate: missing source_ids blocks promotion above research_supported_experimental.
Observation-bearing families: PIT block must declare concrete observed_at_policy and available_at_policy.
node_type records that extend output_radar must declare non_advice_boundary_required in family_specific.required_sections or family_specific.binding.
strategy_profile records with directionality short_only or long_short must reference short / borrow / legal-review validation rules.

lifecycle_states.description: Per-family lifecycle state vocabulary. Patterns kept loose because different entity types have different valid states (e.g., listing: active/suspended/delisted; filing: accepted/amended/withdrawn; event: rumored/announced/confirmed/...).

node_type_id.description: Alias for the top-level id; convenience for prompt consumers.

pit_required.description: True when the node demands PIT-safe inputs for correct operation (backtests, attribution, etc.).

rights_sensitive.description: True when the node operates on licensed or restricted data and must enforce entitlement and redaction.

non_advice_boundary.description: True when any output of the node carries recommendation-like content and must surface a non-advice boundary label.

pit_safe_label.description: Output PIT-safety guarantee. Nodes that consume FRED / Kenneth French current data without vintaged pipeline must declare latest_only or pit_unsafe per CLAUDE §10.17 / §16.10.

event_type_id.description: Alias for the top-level id; convenience for prompt consumers.

insight_type_key.description: Alias for the top-level id; convenience for prompt consumers.

score_weights.description: Map of attribute_key -> weight + caps for the profile's composite score. Aliases score_methodology.weights with a convenience structure.

confidence_impact.description: How a failure should adjust the confidence label of the target (e.g., downgrade_one_step, rejected_or_deferred, no_impact).

fallback_behavior.description: Behaviour when license / credentials are missing (e.g., 'open_locked_preserve_config', 'fall_back_to_eod_public', 'block_with_warning').

allOf.description: Production-required connectors with missing license must fail closed.
